description: The plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across various relation categories. The x-axis is labeled 'Relation Category' and ranges from 0 to 60 in intervals of 10, with a linear scale and no units. The y-axis is labeled 'Mean Interclass Similarity' and spans from 0.0 to 0.5 in intervals of 0.1, also with a linear scale and no units. The plot displays three solid lines representing different conditions: 'w/o DPO obo' in blue, 'w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint' in orange, and 'DPO' in green, each showing variations in mean interclass similarity across the relation categories. The blue line starts at approximately 0.5, decreases to around 0.05 at category 10, and fluctuates between 0.0 and 0.2 thereafter. The orange line begins at around 0.1, peaks at 0.25 near category 3, and then oscillates between 0.05 and 0.4. The green line starts near 0.25, drops to 0.05 at category 3, and continues to fluctuate between 0.0 and 0.2. The averages for 'w/o DPO obo', 'w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint', and 'DPO' are represented by dotted lines in blue, orange, and green, respectively, with values of approximately 0.107, 0.158, and 0.086.
